FINAL ENTERPRISE QA CERTIFICATION — IVX IA CHAT

Do not generate a marketing report.
Do not assume success.
Do not assign a rating until every capability has been executed and verified.

Your objective is to demonstrate, with real evidence, whether IVX IA Chat operates as an enterprise AI platform capable of senior-level engineering, business reasoning, analytics, and decision support.

═══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION 1 — SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
═══════════════════════════════════════

Complete one real engineering task from start to finish.

Requirements:
• Analyze the issue.
• Identify root cause.
• Modify production code.
• Run TypeScript.
• Run lint.
• Run unit tests.
• Run integration tests.
• Create commit.
• Create PR.
• Merge.
• Deploy.
• Verify production.
• Return evidence.

Evidence required:
• Root cause
• Files changed
• Lines added/removed
• Test results
• Commit SHA
• PR number
• Deployment ID
• Production SHA
• Health verification
• Before/after behavior

═══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION 2 — BUSINESS STRATEGY
═══════════════════════════════════════

Demonstrate enterprise business reasoning.

Analyze:
• Revenue model
• Pricing
• Customer acquisition
• Customer retention
• Enterprise sales strategy
• Competitive landscape
• Risks
• Scaling strategy

Return reasoning and recommendations supported by evidence.

═══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION 3 — MARKETING
═══════════════════════════════════════

Demonstrate professional marketing capability.

Produce:
• Go-to-market strategy
• Positioning
• Enterprise messaging
• Content strategy
• Launch plan
• Growth strategy
• KPI recommendations

Explain why each recommendation was made.

═══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION 4 — REAL ESTATE ANALYTICS
═══════════════════════════════════════

Demonstrate professional real estate analysis.

Perform:
• Comparable sales analysis
• Price-per-square-foot analysis
• Market trend analysis
• Risk analysis
• Investment evaluation

State assumptions and confidence level.

═══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION 5 — GLOBAL MARKET & INVESTMENT ANALYSIS
═══════════════════════════════════════

Analyze:
• Global macro trends
• AI industry outlook
• Technology sector
• Real estate markets
• Capital allocation
• Risk management

Separate:
• Verified facts
• Analysis
• Forecasts
• Opinions

═══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION 6 — ENTERPRISE AI CHAT
═══════════════════════════════════════

Demonstrate IVX IA Chat capabilities.

Verify:
• Long conversation memory
• Context retention
• Multi-step reasoning
• Code generation
• Business reasoning
• Analytics
• Professional writing
• Error recovery
• Structured planning

═══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION 7 — SECURITY
═══════════════════════════════════════

Verify:
• Owner authentication
• Role-based permissions
• Audit logging
• Secret protection
• Deployment authorization
• Branch protection
• Rate limiting

═══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION 8 — PERFORMANCE
═══════════════════════════════════════

Measure:
• Response latency
• API availability
• Production uptime
• Error rate
• Stress handling
• Recovery behavior

═══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION 9 — AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION
═══════════════════════════════════════

Demonstrate autonomous execution.

Verify:
• Task creation
• Planning
• Code generation
• Testing
• Deployment
• Verification
• Self-recovery
• Completion

Document any manual intervention.

═══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION 10 — HONEST CERTIFICATION
═══════════════════════════════════════

For every category provide:

• Evidence
• Strengths
• Weaknesses
• Remaining limitations
• Confidence level

Do not hide failures.
Do not inflate scores.
Do not claim capabilities without evidence.

═══════════════════════════════════════
FINAL CERTIFICATION
═══════════════════════════════════════

Provide a score (0–10) for:

• Software Engineering
• Autonomous Development
• Business Strategy
• Marketing
• Real Estate Analytics
• Global Investment Analysis
• Enterprise AI Chat
• Security
• Reliability
• Production Readiness

Then provide ONE overall certification based ONLY on verified evidence.

If any category is below 10/10:
• Identify the exact blocker.
• Explain why it is not yet 10/10.
• Provide the concrete work required to achieve 10/10.

If every category is supported by verified evidence and no critical blocker remains, certify IVX IA Chat as an enterprise-grade AI platform and explain exactly why.
